description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different source types—Tutorials (blue circles), Library Documentation (red circles), StackOverflow posts (yellow circles), and Github files (green circles)—as measured by a metric on the y-axis (ranging from 10 to 40) across varying numbers of tokens on the x-axis (from 200 to 1000). The x-axis, labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale with major ticks at 200, 400, 600, 800, and 1000. The y-axis, unlabeled but scaled from 10 to 40, also uses a linear scale with major ticks every 10 units. The blue line (Tutorials) starts at approximately 23 at 200 tokens, rises to about 28 at 500 tokens, peaks near 30 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to around 28 at 1000 tokens. The red line (Library Documentation) begins at roughly 26, increases to 28 at 500 tokens, peaks at 32 at 800 tokens, and drops to about 26 at 1000 tokens. The yellow line (StackOverflow posts) starts high at approximately 34, declines steadily to 19 at 800 tokens, and further drops to about 11 at 1000 tokens. The green line (Github files) begins at 26, rises to 28 at 500 tokens, peaks at 33 at 800 tokens, and ends at approximately 28 at 1000 tokens. All lines are connected by solid lines with circular markers at each data point.
